example_sentences_in_bangla: সে শুয়োরের গোঁ ধরে কিছুতেই রাজি হল না।
তার শুয়োরের গোঁয়ের কারণে সবাই কষ্ট পেল।
example_sentences_in_english: He wouldn't budge due to his pig-headed stubbornness.
Her extreme stubbornness, like a pig's obstinacy, caused everyone trouble.
note: This idiom draws from the perceived obstinate nature of pigs in rural Bengali life, often used to describe unyielding behavior.
